notes.title: Maid For My Master has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that my newest cute romance visual novel, [i]Maid For My Master[/i], has been released!

This announcement post is a bit late, since the VN was actually released over a week ago, but I had a lot of difficulties trying to post this announcement. I tried to post it multiple times, but for reasons unknown to me, the announcement refused to show up on my developer page and in the community hub of the game itself. I presume this is was because of a bug on Steam's end.

I'm going to hope my announcement posts properly this time, but at this point I'm not holding out much hope lol

ANYWAY

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/744d18ffded921ed2034fe75ce27515cec756b50.png[/img]

[i]Maid For My Master[/i] a wholesome romance story somewhat inspired by [i]Chobits[/i] where you can date a cute robot maid, Holly!

The story is light-hearted and sweet, so it should be perfect if you want to read something relaxing.

The visual novel has an optional r18 patch, but it doesn't add an extensive amount of new scenes. Feel free to miss it if you would rather not read it; it's up to you!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/cbaf9681d0be7a6a8ec3a303b7f37c221bc159d8.png[/img]

You can check out the visual novel here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364490

I hope you enjoy it if you do check it out, and you have a good time with Holly!

- ebi x

notes.title: Ukrainian translation added
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I'm writing this post to let you know that my cute slice of life VN, [i]A Winter's Daydream[/i], has been translated into Ukrainian by Tetiana Bilousova, Viktoriia Karpenko-Komisarova, and Andrew Kovalenko of Sandigo Studio. The translation was edited by Lacki23.

I'm very grateful to everybody who offered their help to translate this visual novel, and to bring it to an even wider audience. I hope that even more people can enjoy the story now!

I also fixed a couple of typos in the English script, and I made a few small edits to a few effects (mostly pans/zooms) to make them look smoother.

Thank you for your continued support, it's very much appreciated. As always, if you find any typos or errors in this new build, please let me know, and I will try to fix things when I can!

- ebi x

notes.title: My Lovey-Dovey Demon has been released! 💗
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I'm writing a quick devlog to let you know that my most recent visual novel, [i]My Lovey-Dovey Demon[/i], has been released! Yay \o/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e869aec72dd4182535668ade5c2d4530d9819120.jpg[/img]

You can check the VN out here, if you're interested:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183430

[i]MLDD[/i] is a VN that's been in process for quite a while. I wrote the script back in 2021, and it took me a while to piece the whole story together. The Steam store page was up for over a year before I finally released it, so some people have been waiting on this one for a while haha

It might have taken me some time to finish this project, but I tried to use this time to ensure that it's as polished as possible! The main artist, [url=https://twitter.com/Kimoreen]Kimoreen[/url], did a great job with the character artwork, and all of the cute chibi cut-ins by [url=https://twitter.com/Konayachi]Konayachi[/url] are adorable!

I also had some help from Harmonie of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44509628]Asminae Games[/url], who created Reborn a Zombie (available for free on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283350]Steam[/url]), to do some work on the various visual effects in this VN. That means this VN has some fun effects during the CGs which I've not added to any of my previous projects such as light rays, animated particles, and moving fog. I think it helps the VN pop, and it brings the story to life!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/76da6cae1c84a845dd2d5c2968af720c4f21c4b5.png[/img]

Speaking of the story, it's a pretty cute, light affair which takes a lot of cues from typical BxG slice of life VNs. It's quite chill and relaxed, and there isn't much in the way of conflict (which might be a bit of a rarity coming from me lol), so this should be a good read if you're looking for something cosy. It's pretty similar to [i]The Language of Love[/i] in that it's a wholesome BxG romance story, though it has a bit more of a comedy focus like [i]My Dear Prince[/i].

Everybody put a lot of effort into this VN, so I hope you all enjoy it! ♡

As always, let me know if you find any typos or bugs in the VN, and I'll try to fix them up within a reasonable timeframe!

- ebi x
